assertion.text: Erdős Problem #942: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $h(n)$ count the number of powerful (if $p\mid m$ then $p^2\mid m$) integers in $[n^2,(n+1)^2)$. Estimate $h(n)$. In particular is there some constant $c>0$ such that\[h(n) < (\log n)^{c+o(1)}\]and, for infinitely many $n$,\[h(n) >(\log n)^{c-o(1)}?\] Prize: no. Tags: number theory.
